entry.summary:
What does work-life balance actually look like for a doctor? At Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora, we believe that a fulfilling medical career should go hand-in-hand with an extraordinary lifestyle.

In this video, GynoMum Michelle shares how relocating to Aotearoa New Zealand opened up a world of adventure, natural beauty, and adult discovery that they never dreamed possible while practising medicine elsewhere.

Learn more about what being an Obstetrician and Gynaecologist with Health New Zealand is like on our website ➡️ healthnz.govt.nz/OG
